topic: Data manipulation and historical data integrity
summary_markdown: The conversation covered technical discussions regarding system architecture, including the use of VPNs within Kubernetes clusters for accessing specific pods. A major focus was placed on data integrity and historical record manipulation. It was discussed that while a mechanism for changing hashing salts (potentially every 72 hours) had been previously promised but abandoned, testing revealed methods to retroactively alter data in `allunite.device_session_concept` using SQL inserts to simulate changes with new salts starting from specific dates (e.g., the first of each month). The possibility of subtly altering historical data was discussed as a potential strategy.
decisions: The technical feasibility of retroactively manipulating session concept data for testing purposes was demonstrated.
